title: triggerprototype.get
description: Retrieve trigger prototypes according to the given parameters.

active.description: Return only enabled trigger prototypes that belong to monitored hosts.

discoveryids.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to the given LLD rules.

functions.description: Return only triggers that use the given functions. Refer to the Supported functions page for a list of supported functions.

group.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to hosts or templates from the host groups or template groups with the given name.

groupids.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to hosts or templates from the given host groups or template groups.

host.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to hosts with the given name.

hostids.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to the given hosts.

inherited.description: If set to true return only trigger prototypes inherited from a template.

maintenance.description: If set to true return only enabled trigger prototypes that belong to hosts in maintenance.

min_severity.description: Return only trigger prototypes with severity greater or equal than the given severity.

monitored.description: Return only enabled trigger prototypes that belong to monitored hosts and contain only enabled items.

templated.description: If set to true return only trigger prototypes that belong to templates.

templateids.description: Return only trigger prototypes that belong to the given templates.

triggerids.description: Return only trigger prototypes with the given IDs.

expandExpression.description: Expand functions and macros in the trigger expression.

selectDependencies.description: Return trigger prototypes and triggers that the trigger prototype depends on in the dependencies property.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return the LLD rule that the trigger prototype belongs to in the discoveryRule property.

selectFunctions.description: Return functions used in the trigger prototype in the functions property. The function objects represent the functions used in the trigger expression and have the following properties: functionid - (ID) ID of the function; itemid - (ID) ID of the item used in the function; function - (string) name of the function; parameter - (string) parameter passed to the function. Query parameter is replaced by $ symbol in returned string.

selectHostGroups.description: Return the host groups that the trigger prototype belongs to in the hostgroups property.

selectHosts.description: Return the hosts that the trigger prototype belongs to in the hosts property.

selectItems.description: Return items and item prototypes used in the trigger prototype in the items property.

selectTags.description: Return the trigger prototype tags in tags property.

selectTemplateGroups.description: Return the template groups that the trigger prototype belongs to in the templategroups property.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to the following subselects: selectHosts - results will be sorted by host.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties.

selectGroups.description: Deprecated. This parameter is deprecated, please use selectHostGroups or selectTemplateGroups instead. Return the host groups and template groups that the trigger prototype belongs to in the groups property.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
